in_sanskrit.name: एकाक्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name derived from the words 'eka' (one) and 'aksh' (eye). It can be used as a name for a person with only one eye, or as a metaphorical name for someone who focuses all their attention on one thing.

in_tamil.name: ஐகக்ஷ்

in_marathi.name: Ekaksh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekaksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekaksh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'eka' meaning 'one' and 'aksh' meaning 'eye'. In Hindu mythology, Ekaksh is a name given to Lord Shiva when he had only one eye after the sacrifice of his second eye. This name symbolizes power, focus, and determination.
